name: Taiiku Kyoushi - 	Iwase Gentarou
original_name: 体育教師 岩瀬源太郎
source:
Turn those cheeky girls into sex slaves!!
All the girls are mine!!

This story goes along with the story of the last work titled "Distance to the Viewfinder", and is from the viewpoint of the bad guy from that work, the brutal gym teacher Iwase Gentaro.
